item.title: Self-Hosted SMTP Test Servers: smtp4dev vs MailDev vs FakeSMTP
item.description: Every application that sends email needs a testing strategy. Sending real emails during development risks spamming users, hitting rate limits, and cluttering inboxes. SMTP test servers solve this by intercepting outbound email traffic, capturing messages locally, and providing a web interface to inspect them — all without delivering anything to real recipients.
